text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-9842: az2 nic drift detected (prefailover threshold). Autopager policies triggered. @SaraG on-call notified.

pagerduty: Incident INC-9842 created and routed to oncall schedule 'infra-az2'. Severity: P1. Pages: Sara G.

Sara G.: ack 1793334450. I'm on it — grabbing recent telemetry and netflow.

Devon L.: taking secondary. heading to Zoom. tagging netops (Kai). 

Kai H.: looking now — I see increasing tx drops on eth0 on the fabric switch for az2-rack-07, flapping every ~15s. BGP hold timers look fine but retransmits spiking.

Maria P.: customers reporting elevated 5xxs for hosted endpoints in eu-west-az2. Spike started ~1793334400. Investigating correlation with autoscaler and eviction logs.

Sara G.: ops-bot auto-mitigation: applied prefailover divert: set routing.weight[az2]=0.6 -> 0.2, ramp window 60s.

ops-bot: diverts applied to route-group rg-eu-west-az2 -> new weights: az1:0.1, az2:0.2, az3:0.7. Canary traffic moved.

Devon L.: running quick KV cache health check: 
```
curl -sS https://internal-metrics/api/kvcache?az=az2 | jq '.evictions, .hit_rate'
# result: ["evictions": 1245, "hit_rate": 0.82]
```
Evictions up 3x vs baseline, hit_rate down ~6%. Might be related.

Kai H.: net logs show PHY errors and link flaps on NICs -> vendor ticket opened. Eng-infra recommended BGP graceful restart config toggle to reduce transient failovers.

pagerduty: 10m elapsed, no ack from secondary oncall, escalating to schedule 'infra-leads'.

Sara G.: noted. Devon, can you set a temporary qdisc drop to limit connection queues? We want to avoid thrashing.

Devon L.: applied tc qdisc on inference-* nodes in az2 (limit 200 connections). Command used: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root netem loss 1%`. Observing reduced connection resets.

Maria P.: customer impact update: 12% of requests to eu-west show >500ms tail latency, error rate for POST/generate rose to 2.4% (baseline 0.2%). Affected tenants: several mid-market customers using Dedicated in az2. Notifying CSMs.

Sara G.: decision: keep prefailover active. Begin gradual traffic shift to az3 until link stable. If errors don't drop below 0.5% in 10m, escalate to full failover.

ops-bot: scheduled recheck at +5m and +15m.

Kai H.: vendor doing remote re-seat of transceiver, but they recommend replacing SFP; ETA 45m. NIC flaps persist on two hosts.

Devon L.: initiated instance-level evacuation for two noisy hosts in az2: migrating active shards to az3. Command summary: `evacuate-host --host rack-07-node-12 --target az3` (jobs queued).

pagerduty: escalation to primary infra lead (Maria P.) at 1793335060.

Maria P.: acknowledged escalation. Coordinating with customer success on visible impact and running status page update. Draft status: "Partial service degradation in eu-west-az2 affecting a subset of customers; traffic being diverted to adjacent AZs. Investigating networking issue; mitigation in progress." Send when we confirm stabilization.

Sara G.: traffic metrics check at 1793335200: errors down to 1.0%, p50 latency stable, p99 improving. Continuing ramp to az3.

Devon L.: migration tasks showing 6/8 shards moved off noisy hosts. No data loss; re-replicating as expected.

ops-bot: autopager suggests retention of prefailover for 30m post-stabilization.

Kai H.: vendor confirms SFP replacement on order. We'll monitor. For now link flaps reduced after remote reseat.

Maria P.: status update posted to status.redwood.ai (draft -> published) at 1793335405. CSM notified top-5 affected accounts.

Sara G.: closing loop: set follow-up action items — 1) replace SFPs in rack-07, 2) add link-level EarlyDrop to detect future drift, 3) run postmortem with netops + infra. ETA for postmortem doc by EOD.

Devon L.: handing back to Sara G. for watch window. I remain on standby.

Sara G.: monitoring. If error rate <0.5% for 30m we will start unwinding prefailover and ramp traffic back. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-9842 remains P1; next auto-check at 1793336220.

pagerduty: incident acknowledged by Sara G. at 1793334450; last update logged at 1793335405.
